subject: SkyBeam onboarding: invoice without PO?
messages:
From: Aisha Kumar <aisha.kumar@skybeam.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor setup / pilot invoicing question
Attachments: SkyBeam_W9.pdf, Statement_of_Work_SkyBeam_v1.docx

Hi Sofia and Dev,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to kick off the 3-week pilot. Finance asked me to check on Redwood's vendor onboarding and PO process: our standard is to invoice net 30 without requiring a PO for pilots under $20k. To keep things moving we can send the signed SOW and W-9 (attached).

Can SkyBeam be set up to invoice us without a formal PO for this pilot? If not, what information or approvals do you need from our side to request an exception?

High level:
- Pilot value: $9,500 (one invoice, Net 30)
- Start date: 2026-05-24
- Contact for billing: finance@skybeam.io

Happy to provide any additional paperwork — we can also sign Redwood's vendor agreement addendum if that helps.

Best,
Aisha Kumar
Head of BD, SkyBeam Analytics
[Attachment: SkyBeam_W9.pdf, Statement_of_Work_SkyBeam_v1.docx]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Kumar <aisha.kumar@skybeam.io>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup / pilot invoicing question

Hi Aisha — thanks for the SOW and W-9, and congrats on getting to pilot. Short answer: Redwood's standard is that all vendor invoices are matched to a PO. Exceptions are allowed but require procurement + finance sign-off and a documented business justification.

To move quickly, can you confirm the following so we can request the exception formally?
- Confirmed total invoice amount and expected invoice date (you listed $9,500, one invoice)
- Copy of SkyBeam's standard payment terms and remittance instructions (or confirm net 30)
- Any additional vendor paperwork (tax form is good; if you have an insurance cert or commercial terms, include them)

If you can send those, I'll open an exception request ticket with Procurement and loop in Finance. FYI, Procurement will typically only grant a limited one-time exception for onboarding pilots below $15k; if you expect subsequent invoices, we'll need a PO.

Dev — can you confirm this pilot scope on your end and whether Sales can absorb any onboarding-related risk if Finance asks for a chargeback?

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Manager, Vendor Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment referenced: Statement_of_Work_SkyBeam_v1.docx]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Kumar <aisha.kumar@skybeam.io>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 12:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor setup / pilot invoicing question

Thanks for the context — looping in so the vendor can proceed. Procurement policy recap: new vendors must be onboarded with a PO unless an exception is approved in writing. Exceptional approvals are granted only when:
- The total liability is under $15k AND
- The vendor has submitted required tax forms (W-9) and acceptable payment terms, AND
- Legal/Finance review for any unusual terms.

Given SkyBeam's pilot value ($9.5k) and that we have a W-9 and SOW, I approve a one-time exception to allow SkyBeam to invoice without a PO for this pilot only. Conditions:
1) SkyBeam signs the attached Quick Payment Addendum (I attached a short terms doc: SkyBeam_Terms_Quick.docx)
2) Finance must receive the invoice with the approved exception ticket number referenced
3) This exception covers the single invoice; any follow-up work must be covered by a PO or a new approved exception

Dev — please open the vendor record in Coupa (or our vendor master) and attach the signed W-9 + SOW. Sofia — please capture this approval on PROC-8342 and set the exception expiry to 2026-06-30.

Laura Bennett
Director, Procurement
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: SkyBeam_Terms_Quick.docx]

Laura / Sofia — amazing, thank you for the fast turnaround and the exception approval. We'll sign the Quick Payment Addendum and send it back via DocuSign (link below). Expect the signed addendum + final invoice by 2026-05-25.

Thanks again — looking forward to a smooth pilot.

Best,
Aisha
